Privacy Policy for GeoForensics

GeoForensics is a locally hosted desktop application. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting it.

Data Collection and Use: This application does not collect, store, transmit, or share any personal information, telemetry, user data, or files. All file processing is performed entirely locally on your device. The embedded web server binds to 127.0.0.1 only and serves only files discovered by the current scan.

Network Access: The only network requests the application makes are for map tiles (from the tile provider you select) and, if you enable auto-updates, release checks against this project's GitHub releases. No evidence data is ever included in these requests.

Third-Party Access: Because no data is collected, no data is shared with or sold to any third parties.

Transparency and Open Source: GeoForensics is open source, meaning anyone can inspect the source code to verify these claims. You can view the code and follow development on GitHub at: https://github.com/silvance/Geo-Forensics

Contact: If you have any questions regarding this privacy policy, please open an issue at https://github.com/silvance/Geo-Forensics/issues
